name: View Energy
body:
You can imbue your eyes with akashic energy, allowing you to see the life energy that flows through living things.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, Wis 13, Perception 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): Once per day, you can invest essence into this feat. While essence is invested in this feat you can spend a move action to activate a special mode of sensory perception, called akashic sight, which allows you to accurately detect and pinpoint living creatures, regardless of invisibility or lighting conditions. This akashich sight has a range equal to 5 feet per point of invested essence. The akashich sight lasts until the start of your next turn.

If you have the ability to bind a veil to your Headband slot, the akashic sight granted by this feat is capable of detecting both living and nonliving creatures.

You gain 1 point of essence.
